# Provenance Filings API

> Source-linked SEC filing facts for developers and AI agents. Independent of, and not
> affiliated with, the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission. No market data, no advice.

## Use
- Try without signup: header `X-API-Key: demo` (or `?api_key=demo`) on read-only endpoints; showcase companies only (the chat answers about every loaded company), limit<=10, 20 requests/minute. Playground: /playground/
- Base URL: this host. All /v1 endpoints need header `X-API-Key`.
- OpenAPI 3.1: /openapi.json . Swagger UI: /docs .
- Errors: {"error": {"code": str, "message": str, "request_id": str}}. 429 carries Retry-After.
- Timestamps ISO 8601 UTC with Z. Dates YYYY-MM-DD. Missing data is null, never 0.

## MCP server (for AI agents)
- POST /mcp  Model Context Protocol, Streamable HTTP transport, JSON responses. Send your key as X-API-Key or Authorization: Bearer; without one the demo key and its limits apply.
- Tools: search_companies, company_overview, get_figures (as_of), list_filings, rank_companies, search_filings, recent_events, listing_events, company_connections, insider_transactions, companies_going_public. Each result keeps source_url and accession_number; cite them.
- Claude Code: claude mcp add --transport http provenance https://THIS-HOST/mcp --header "X-API-Key: YOUR_KEY"

## Endpoints
- GET /v1/companies?exchange=&sic=&state=&ingested=true|false&sort={name|cik|last_processed}&limit<=200&offset=
- GET /v1/companies/search?q={ticker|cik|name}&limit=1..50  match_type is cik, ticker, name_exact (ignoring Inc., Corp. and the like), name_prefix, name_contains, former_name (with matched_name: "facebook" finds Meta Platforms) or name_fuzzy
  match_type: cik, ticker, name_exact, name_prefix, name_contains; name_fuzzy (a typo, e.g. "mircosoft") only when nothing else matches.
- GET /v1/companies/{cik}  (202 + Retry-After while on-demand ingestion runs; 404 if unknown)
- GET /v1/companies/{cik}/filings?limit=1..100&form_type=&since=YYYY-MM-DD&offset=
- GET /v1/companies/{cik}/facts?metric={revenue|operating_income|net_income|total_assets|operating_cash_flow}&period={annual|quarterly|all}&from=&to=&form_type=&include_derived=false&include_all_observations=false&as_of=YYYY-MM-DD  (as_of: only observations filed by that date; restatements filed later are invisible)
- GET /v1/companies/{cik}/freshness
- GET /v1/companies/{cik}/overview?as_of=  one company for one page, any company: identity (display name, LEI and how matched, incorporation and its source, auditor), key_figures with change_pct and ttm (derived: the last 4 quarters summed for flows, the latest quarter-end for balances; null unless all 4 quarters are present, consecutive and in one unit), ten fiscal years, events, 13F ownership, segments, insider activity, leadership. Every value has source_url, accession_number, source_tag, mapping_version, quality_status. Stored data only; demo key: showcase companies
- GET /v1/companies/{cik}/statements/{income|balance|cash_flow}?period={annual|quarterly}&periods=1..20 annual (12) or 1..80 quarterly (40)&as_of=&include_derived=true  the whole statement: columns oldest first, rows of cells (each the /facts value for that period, with its filing; null when missing). Derived rows (gross/operating/net margin in %, current_ratio and debt_to_equity in x, free_cash_flow) and Q4s derived as FY less 9M carry derived=true, formula and inputs. Reporting currency, never converted. 404 no_statement_data when empty
- GET /v1/companies/{cik}/timeline?types=filing,8k_item,officer_change,auditor_change,ipo,insider,13f_quarter&from=&to=&as_of=&limit=1..200&cursor=  newest first; each item has date, type, event_type, a plain title, filing_url and details; upcoming=true only for derived future dates (lock-up ends); page with meta.next_cursor. Information, not signals
- Watchlists (your own key; not the demo key): POST /v1/watchlists {"name","ciks","columns"} ; GET /v1/watchlists ; GET|PATCH|DELETE /v1/watchlists/{id} ; GET /v1/watchlists/{id}/rows?as_of= (one row per company: metric columns are the latest annual statement cell plus yoy; also reporting_currency, latest_filing, last_event, holders_change; null when missing) ; GET /v1/watchlists/{id}/events (timeline parameters) ; POST /v1/watchlists/{id}/watch {"destination_type","destination"} (one company watch each). Limits: free 3 lists, paid plans 25; 50 companies and 8 columns a list; 422 watchlist_limit_reached. Another key's list is 404; revoking a key deletes its lists
- GET /v1/companies/{cik}/graph?include=insiders,interlocks,holders,subsidiaries&former=false&as_of=YYYY-MM-DD  connections as nodes and edges; each edge has evidence (form, accession, filing date, EDGAR URL). Insiders from Forms 3/4/5, interlocks = other companies the same insiders file at, holders above 5% from structured Schedules 13D/G, subsidiaries from 10-K exhibit 21 (with names new or gone since the year before). refreshing=true while EDGAR sources are read for a keyed caller
- GET /v1/companies/{cik}/insiders?former=false&as_of=  directors, officers, 10% owners: role, since, last filed, shares held, open-market buys and sells over 12 months, other companies
- GET /v1/ipos?days=90&since=&stage=&kind=ipo|spin_off&limit=1..200&offset=  companies going public, newest activity first: stage confidential (DRS), filed (S-1, F-1, Form 10), amended, effective, listing (8-A, exchange certification), priced (424B4) or withdrawn (RW), each milestone with its filing. Only first-time registrants; EDGAR is read every hour
- GET /v1/companies/{cik}/insider-transactions?code=P,S&since=&as_of=&owner_cik=&limit=1..100&offset=  transaction codes: P purchase, S sale, A award, M option exercise, F tax withholding, G gift
- GET /v1/companies/{cik}/subsidiaries?as_of=   and   GET /v1/companies/{cik}/holders?below=false&as_of=
- GET /v1/facts/screen?metric=&year=YYYY&period={annual|quarterly}&quarter={1-4}&unit=USD&order={desc|asc}&as_of=YYYY-MM-DD  one row per company, latest period ending in that calendar year (or calendar quarter, with period=quarterly)
- GET /v1/search?q=&cik=&form=&as_of=YYYY-MM-DD&mode={keyword|semantic}&limit=1..20  companies by name, ticker or CIK (and by the words of their profiles) plus passages from stored filing sections (prospectus sections, 8-K item 5.02, earnings releases), each with its filing link and a snippet; mode=semantic finds passages by meaning (your own key only; the demo key gets 403 semantic_needs_key and sees showcase companies' passages only)
- GET /v1/companies/{cik}/profile  a readable Markdown profile (identity, latest annual figures, revenue by fiscal year, going public, leadership changes, the latest prospectus's risk factor categories, recent filings), every figure linked to its filing, plus a short cited "summary" and its "citations"
- GET /v1/facts/screen/periods?metric=&period=&unit=  calendar years and quarters that have data, with company counts
- POST /v1/chat {"message","cik"?,"as_of"?,"session_id"?,"context"?,"history"?}  send back the previous reply's "context" and the last exchanges as "history" [{"q","a"}] so follow-ups ("their revenue", "it") refer to the previous answer; questions across companies (recent IPOs, who filed a form, the largest by revenue, counts of filings) are answered from the data with a "table" widget whose cells link to filings; company intelligence: cited brief (metrics, filings, 8-K 5.02 changes with names, roles, dates, reasons and the filing sentence) plus a local-model answer with grounding checks; "widgets" holds charts (a metric by fiscal year with computed growth, for trend questions, which are answered from the data) or tiles of the latest annual figures; companies going public (no annual figures yet) and questions about an offering or its risks are answered from passages of the latest S-1/F-1/424B prospectus, cited by section (brief.coverage.prospectus); forecast questions ("Forecast Microsoft revenue for the next 4 years") return intent "forecast" and a "forecast" widget (cited history plus low/base/high projections computed from growth rates a local reasoning model chose over the filings, the latest earnings release and cited news headlines; estimates, not reported figures); "intent" is coverage, ipos, filers, filing_count, rank, list_followup, out_of_scope, figure, summary (a "summarise X" question answered from the company profile, no model), leadership, trend, forecast or question; the demo key covers every loaded company from stored data; with your own key the conversation is saved and session_id returned
- GET /v1/chat/sessions ; GET /v1/chat/sessions/{id} ; DELETE /v1/chat/sessions/{id}  saved conversations for your key (not the demo key)
- GET /v1/events?after={cursor}&since=&types={filing,leadership,listing}&cik=&form_type=&items=5.02&mic=&event_type=&limit<=100  one ordered feed of new SEC filings (with their 8-K items), officer changes read from 8-K item 5.02 (type sec.officer_change: person, role, change, effective date, reason, successor, the filing sentence as evidence, verified, and point-in-time context: revenue growth and operating margin before the change and over the person's tenure against SIC peers), and listing events; pass next_cursor as after
- GET /v1/events/stream  same feed as Server-Sent Events (X-API-Key header; resume with Last-Event-ID; demo key not accepted)
- POST /v1/watches {"cik","destination_type":"webhook|email","destination"} ; GET /v1/watches ; DELETE /v1/watches/{id} ; GET /v1/watches/{id}/deliveries
- POST /v1/listing-watches {"scope_type":"mic|country|region","scope_value":"XPAR|FR|europe","event_types"?:["new_listing","delisting","suspended"],"destination_type":"webhook|email","destination"} ; GET /v1/listing-watches ; DELETE /v1/listing-watches/{id} ; GET /v1/listing-watches/{id}/deliveries  signed like filing watches; X-Event-Type is listing.<event_type>; counts toward the plan's active watches
- GET /v1/developer/usage?from=&to=  totals by route plus "daily": requests and errors per UTC day ; GET/DELETE /v1/developer/api-keys
- GET /v1/exports/facts?metric=&ciks=a,b&format={csv|json}&limit<=1000
- GET /v1/exports/company-years?ciks=a,b&from_year=&to_year=&format={csv|json}&limit=  one row per company and fiscal year: revenue, operating_income, net_income, total_assets, operating_cash_flow (USD, from each year's annual report) and each figure's filing link; give ciks (max 50) or one fiscal year (from_year = to_year) across all companies; your own key only
- GET /v1/stats  (public, no key; coverage and health of this deployment, cached 30s)
- GET /v1/public/plans  (public; plan limits and pilot pricing)
- GET /v1/public/companies  (public; showcase companies with latest filing and latest annual revenue)
- GET /v1/public/companies/{cik}  (public; profile, latest 10 filings, annual figures, freshness; showcase only)
- GET /v1/public/listings/events  (public; recent new listings, delistings, suspensions on covered CA/EU/UK venues)
- POST /v1/developer/key-requests {"email","use_case","plan"}  (public, rate limited; operator approves)
- Accounts (browser, session cookie): /account/ to sign in by emailed one-time link, then create, name and revoke keys, see usage, pick the chat and Explorer theme. API: POST /v1/account/sign-in {email} ; POST /v1/account/verify {token} ; GET/PATCH /v1/account ; POST /v1/account/keys ; DELETE /v1/account/keys/{id} ; POST /v1/account/sign-out[-everywhere]

## International listings (Canada / Europe / UK; key required)
- GET /v1/markets/  venues covered (MIC, country, region, counts)
- GET /v1/markets/instruments?mic=&country=&region={canada|europe|uk}&status={listed|delisted|suspended}&q={issuer name|symbol|ISIN|LEI}&first_trade_since=  each listing has issuer_requested (FIRDS IssrReq: a likely primary listing when true)
- GET /v1/markets/instruments/{isin}  listings across venues + issuer (LEI)
- GET /v1/markets/events?event_type={new_listing,ipo,delisting,modified,suspended,reinstated}&region=&mic=&isin=&since=  new_listing details carry issuer_requested and likely_primary_listing
- GET /v1/markets/issuers/{lei}
- new_listing = instrument first traded on a venue recently; NOT an IPO determination. ipo only when the source states it.
- Sources: ESMA FIRDS, FCA FIRDS, GLEIF (CC0). Rows carry source.

## Interpreting facts
- Every fact has source_url (SEC filing index), source_tag (XBRL concept), accession_number,
  mapping_version, quality_status in {ok, partial, ambiguous_mapping, invalid_source_value, suspicious_period, derived}; suspicious_period = period ends before 1993 or 2+ years after the filing, never the latest figure.
- period_class is computed from period dates: annual, quarterly, ytd, other. A ytd value is not a quarter.
- fiscal_year/fiscal_period are the SEC labels of the filing (a 10-K's comparative for last year carries this year's fy). period_fiscal_year and period_label ("FY2025", "Q1 FY2026") name the period itself: use those.
- derived=true values are computed by subtraction of two reported year-to-date values; cite them as derived.
- Default facts view returns one observation per period (latest filed); include_all_observations=true shows restatements.
- accepted_at is the SEC acceptance timestamp when available; source_published_at is always null.

## Limits
- Plan limits (requests a minute and a month, export rows, watches) are served live at GET /v1/public/plans; read them there rather than from this file.
- Metrics come from us-gaap and ifrs-full tags as filed; company-specific extension tags are not mapped. The current metric list is the metric parameter of GET /v1/companies/{cik}/facts in /openapi.json, and coverage is described at /coverage/.
- Freshness depends on a 5-minute poll interval and SEC propagation; no latency SLA.

## Attribution
Cite values with their source_url. Data: SEC EDGAR (https://www.sec.gov). Review the filing before relying on a value.
